author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@paulwalk Wow Paul, thanks for the work on Dublin Core, I added to the page. The hard part is does metadata exist if nothing consumes it? Scalar and Omeka, do not seem to parse DC (best I can tell).

In terms of #IndieWeb just encouraging #DigitalHumanities is good
